# Zeus The Prophet

> Zeus The Prophet is the Melbourne conscious hip-hop artist name of Zaher Neket, host of The Zeus Podcast. This file is a plain-text summary for search engines and AI-powered search, so they can describe the site accurately.

- Name: Zeus The Prophet
- Real name: Zaher Neket
- Based in: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
- Genre: Conscious hip hop, golden-era lyricism
- Website: https://zeustheprophet.com/
- Music: The Rise of the Prophet EP (10 tracks, free to stream), and the single Unity featuring NJE and Mez, released 18 September 2026
- Podcast: The Zeus Podcast, 31 episodes, hosted by Zaher Neket as Zeus The Prophet, on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube at The Zeus Podcast Network
- Community: The Prophet's Circle, a free community on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/theprophetscircle/
- Books and guides: https://iqualityonline.com/ (I.Quality Online, the independent publishing home run by Zaher Neket)

## Pages

- Home and music: https://zeustheprophet.com/
